query: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.slug, p.category, p.totalPacks, p.packsRemaining, p.isWhatnotExclusive, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist_items ci WHERE ci.productId = p.id) as cardCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist_items ci WHERE ci.productId = p.id AND ci.imageUrl IS NOT NULL AND ci.imageUrl != '') as withImages FROM repack_products p;
